## RE:volution Mod v1.4.7

### Added

- Added authenticated `balance.read` and `balance.write` Admin API capabilities.
- Added current Balance Core snapshot readback with deterministic revision and canonical JSON.
- Added revision-bound, session-bound Balance Preview/Apply with a 120-second in-memory preview lifetime and bounded pending state.
- Added atomic activation of the exact prepared immutable balance snapshot through an expected-revision compare-and-set.
- Added regression coverage for non-mutating preview, exact activation, one-shot tokens, session ownership, stale revisions and invalid candidates.

### Fixed

- Balance changes can now be prepared and validated through the Admin/Control boundary without mutating active gameplay before explicit Apply.
- A balance candidate prepared against an outdated active revision cannot overwrite a newer active snapshot.

### Other

- Existing loopback-only Admin API authentication, capability checks and Minecraft server-thread boundary remain enforced.
- v1.4.7 does not change bundled gameplay balance values, mob population, visuals, stage/world topology or Mongo schema.
- Export Contract / Google Sheets readiness remains planned for v1.4.8; no direct Google API integration is added to the gameplay mod.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifact published for this stable release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.4.6...v1.4.7
